pin.why: A2 §8: cliff-hung waterfalls straight into the sea. `sea-waterfall` (D-B4), not `knickpoint-gorge`: the gorge's biomes are river,rock and its requires block is nearFlag RIVER, so it can never be satisfied at a cell that also satisfies water.kind sea — a G-PIN-SAT failure by construction. This is the exact unsatisfiable-coastal-pin the addition exists to prevent
